services.desc: There’s always more to the story. The new 60-minute audio tour helps you make the most of your visit to The Mob Museum, uncovering more than what you’ll see in the exhibits. Explore at your own pace while guided narration highlights the can’t-miss artifacts and dives deeper into the history of organized crime in America. Do you know how Al Capone was finally put behind bars? Ever wondered whether Frank Sinatra was “connected”? Have you heard that the CIA partnered with mobsters to try to assassinate Cuban leader Fidel Castro? Or questioned whether mobsters went after people outside the Mob? services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Travel back in time to the Prohibition era, when thousands of speakeasies operating in hard-to-find places satisfied the nation’s thirst for forbidden spirits. Informative and entertaining exhibits, videos and artifacts tell the stories of the Roaring Twenties, which saw the rise of flappers, jazz and the Mob. The speakeasy exhibit is built around a well-stocked bar and space for a stage for evening entertainment, creating a lively environment inspired by that bygone age. The Underground at The Mob Museum can accommodate groups as small as 10 or as large as 130 for all types of private events.
